notes: Modified-accrual/accrual statements (governmental funds balance sheet, proprietary net position with depreciation), so basis GAAP. Governmental receipts/disbursements from Total Governmental Funds column (p4); debt service Principal and Interest and fees are printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses), below Total expenditures, so recorded as disbursements with outside_printed_total. Object-listed governmental lines assigned the dominant fund's function. ending_cash = cash + county treasurer from governmental funds balance sheet (p3); certificates of deposit as ending_investments. Business-type from proprietary statement Total column (pp6-7); totals = operating + nonoperating (computed). The only supplementary schedule is the combined all-funds budgetary schedule (p10), so per user rule detail is one line per individual fund column of the governmental funds (p4) and proprietary funds (pp6-7) statements; the budget schedule lines are not recorded. Interest income/expense in proprietary detail are nonoperating lines outside the printed total operating revenues/expenses. Read pages 1-10 of 10
